run_inference_on_aria_sequences: run EVL model inference on Aria sequences with a specified input path and model checkpoint
run_inference_with_custom_voxel_resoluti: run EVL model inference with a custom voxel resolution for volumetric fusion
run_obb_only_inference: run OBB-only prediction skipping occupancy and volume fusion for faster inference on long sequences
run_inference_with_snippet_overlap: run EVL model inference with a custom snippet stride to control overlap between snippets
run_inference_skipping_video_generation: run EVL model inference on Aria sequences while skipping video generation for faster output
